Derive a per-pixel image identity from a peak matrix

Source: R/image_id.R
derive_image_id_from_pkm.Rd

Internal helper returning a factor with one entry per pixel (row of pkm$intensity) that identifies which image/run each pixel belongs to, so that peak matrices coming from different input paths share one representation.

The identity is taken, in order of preference, from:

  1. pkm$image_id, as added by cardinal_to_peakmatrix().

  2. pkm$numPixels and pkm$names, as carried natively by rMSI2 rMSIprocPeakMatrix objects with more than one image: pixels are concatenated in contiguous row-blocks following that order.

If neither describes more than one image, every pixel is assigned to a single image (named after pkm$names[1] when available).

Usage

derive_image_id_from_pkm(pkm)

Arguments

pkm

Peak matrix list containing at least intensity.

Value

A factor of length nrow(pkm$intensity), with levels in order of first appearance.
